🏷️ Roles & Titles

Access roles decide what a member can do. Titles are just a name (Captain, Chief…) — a member with a title has the same access as a Responder. Deleting one takes it off every member who has it. 🔒 Responder, Dispatcher, Captain and Chief can't be deleted.

Access roles
Titles
🔒 Security
Accounts that still need their own password

Members who have never set their own password — or were told to change it — may still be using a password other people know. Securing them gives each account a random password nobody knows and emails the member a one-time link to set their own. Members who already chose their own password aren't affected. These texts always go to the member, even in Test Mode.

Forces every user (except yourself) to set a brand new password the next time they log in. Useful if a shared/default password may have been compromised.
⚠ This affects every user account immediately and cannot be undone.

Most devices a member can be signed in on

A phone or computer counts once a member signs in on it, until they sign out (devices not used in 30 days don't count). When a member is already at the limit, signing in on another device is refused with a message — they sign out on one first, or you sign them out of one in Users ▸ Devices. System admins are never limited. 0 = no limit.

devices per member
Home screen tiles by role

Tick which roles see each tile on the home screen (phone and computer). A member sees a tile if any of their roles is ticked. The Admin column is for admins — untick a tile there to hide it from admins too. Protocol Search has its own setting in the Protocol Search tab.

🔔 Notification Settings

Every notification the system sends, and how it goes out. Each box is separate — with Push and Text on, people get both. Ticks save straight away. Tap a message name to edit its wording.

💬 Responder texts — 833-841-1732

Responders on a call can text this number; the text pops up on that call's Manage Call page and the dispatcher's reply is texted back from the same number. ClickSend needs this link once (Messaging ▸ Inbound rules ▸ Action: URL).

Check that each way of reaching people works. Every test goes only to you — your phone number, your email, and the phones / computers where you've turned on push notifications.

📅 Availability notifications

Rewrite any outgoing text. Drag a variable into the message — or tap it — and it drops in where the cursor is. A line whose variables are all empty is left out automatically, so optional details never leave a blank line.

🧪 Test Mode
Test Mode — just for you
Everything you trigger goes only to you. Nobody else is affected.
🧪 Test Mode is ON for you.
While it's on:
  • Texts, emails and app notifications you trigger go only to your own phone and email, marked [TEST].
  • Calls you post are saved as test calls, kept apart from real calls in the logs.
  • It's the same switch as ⚙ My Settings ▸ Test Mode (phone and computer), and it stays on until you turn it off.
🏢 Organization

Your organization's name, logo, colors and unit numbering. Changes apply to the desktop, the phone app, the caller's location page, printouts and outgoing texts the next time each one loads. Leave a box empty to use the built-in default.

Name
Logo
Upload your logo to an image host (for example imgbb.com), then paste the direct image link here. A square PNG with a transparent background looks best. Emails need a real web link, so a file from your computer won't work here.

📘 Protocol Search
Protocol Search finds the steps in the NJ EMS protocol that match a question and shows each one highlighted on its page. It doesn't write answers and can miss the passage someone needs. It is a reference aid only — not medical direction — and nobody should rely on it for patient care. Every user sees this warning and must accept it before their first search.
Who can use it
Open Protocol Search ↗
The protocol file
Checking…
Update to a new protocol version
When the state publishes a new NJ EMS protocol, choose the new PDF here. It's checked on this computer first (it must look like the NJ protocol), you see what was found, and only then is it published to everyone. The old version stays in the site's history.
🚧 Closure Notifications

Road closures and hospital diverts. Saving records one; nothing is sent until you press Notify units, which texts every unit. In Test Mode, texts go only to you and nothing is marked as sent.

🚧 Road closures
Closures are placed on the map and sorted into the coverage area they fall in.
Loading closures…
🏥 Hospital diverts
Record a hospital that's on divert and tell the units. Check the live status in 🏥 Hospital Diversion Status (or the official NJ page).
Loading diverts…
🚙 Vehicle Shifts
Approve or deny ERV and rig shift requests. Each request shows the driver's reason. A clash with an approved shift has to be sorted out before you can approve.
📅 Availability
Who is available in the daytime each day of the week. Members fill it in on the 📅 Availability home tile; it starts over when the week resets (set below). The reminder and the morning summary are set in 🔔 Notification Settings ▸ 📅 Availability.
🌙 Night Shifts
The units on each night. Members see this on the 🌙 Night Shifts tile (it can't be edited there). Change a unit, ✕ removes one, type a unit and press + Add to add one, then 💾 Save night shifts.
🚑 Fleet

Take a rig out of service and it stops being offered to dispatchers on both apps — it's skipped by "Add Additional Rig" and flagged in the rig picker. Set an optional return time and it comes back automatically.

🏠 Home Base Map

The items a responder can pick when a rig, ERV or jump bag is out of something and they don't have time to restock it (Service Helpdesk ▸ New ▸ 📦 Restock). "Should have" is what the rig normally carries — it's shown next to the item. Changes reach the request form the next time someone opens it.

Tap ▸ on a section to see and edit its items. Saving saves both checklists.
Loading…
📥 Building Codes From Businesses

Businesses share their door code on the Sign Builder after confirming their phone by text. Nothing reaches dispatch until you approve it here. Check the details — call the contact if you're not sure — then approve or reject.

🔑 Codes & Locations Editor
Dispatch Console Settings

These tables drive the dispatch console on both desktop and mobile: which PD / BLS / ALS the console suggests for a town, the transport hospital list, which natures flash ALS, and who to call for out-of-area calls. Changes apply the next time a dispatcher signs in.

Every caller-location link from the last 24 hours, live. Pins show callers who are sharing; pick one — on the map or in the list — to see the path their phone has reported and to text them directly. Their replies appear here.

📋 ImageTrend — Pre-fill the PCR

The moment a call is posted, a PCR is started in ImageTrend Elite with what CallDashboard knows: address, GPS, nature, patient age / sex, crew, the key times, hospital and outcome. It's updated as those come in, always the same incident; anything not known stays blank for the crew. Notes, the callback number and door codes are never sent. Members' license numbers are in Users ▸ Edit.
